dedupe_keys.name: flo 2d dam and tailings dam breach modelling

description: Commercial flood routing software used to model tailings dam failures. The FLO-2D page says the software, a flood routing and hydraulic model, can simulate the breach of a tailings dam and the flooding that follows, using the dam's geometry, geotechnical characteristics and hydraulic conditions, and computes flow rates, velocities, depths and inundation areas of the released tailings, for emergency response planning, risk assessment and mitigation design. It is a paid desktop software download sold by subscription, which includes technical support and free training webinars. Coverage is any site the user models. Caveats: pricing and the licence terms are not stated on the page read, and results depend on rheology inputs. For simulation it maps where a tailings flow would reach roads, rail, water intakes and towns, for downstream consequence studies. A related catalogue record is the tailings dam breach runout characteristics dataset.
